Your practical guide to entering data in myHealthCare V2: real screens, what to click and what to type. All patient names and data are invented.

About this guide

We have two versions of the Nego Team application: V1 and V2. The business team has always entered data in myHealthCare V1. We are now moving to V2.

This guide shows how V2 works, screen by screen. Its purpose is also to let you check that V2 screens, functions and data entry steps behave exactly like V1. The only differences are the ones that have been documented and approved. Each of them is flagged on its screen with a button called « What is different in V2 », and some screens have a « Compare with V1 » button.

1 · Read the example
Mrs Claire EXEMPLE, an invented patient, takes us from the first phone call to the end of her treatment.
2 · Follow the screens
Open « Training, screen by screen ». Orange rings show what to click or fill, and the arrow shows the next button.
3 · Spot a difference?
If a screen in V2 does not match what you know from V1 and no button mentions it, note it and tell the project team.

The screens in this guide are drawn copies of the real V2 screens, built from them and checked against the real application, with invented data. They are not photographs, so no real patient ever appears. Where you see « Admin » and « Technician » views, they show what each role sees.

1 · The example 2 · Training, screen by screen

Monday, 9:00. The Admin takes a call from a prescribing doctor, Dr TESTARD. His patient, Mrs Claire EXEMPLE, 58, from Créteil (94), has just been diagnosed with sleep apnoea. She needs a CPAP machine (PPC) at home. Her primary insurance is the CPAM TEST 94, her complementary insurance the MUTUELLE EXEMPLE. The doctor e-mails the prescription.

The Admin and the Technician share the work. By the end of the day Mrs EXEMPLE must exist in Salesforce with her treatment case, her machine, her rental contract and her weekly billing, so that technicians can follow her and the CPAM and mutuelle can be billed.

AdminReceives the referral. Checks the doctor and payers, opens the treatment case, writes the contract (administrator profile).
TechnicianRegisters the patient, installs and records the machine, plans the visits, replaces parts (technician profile).
Mrs Claire EXEMPLEThe new patient (invented).
Dr TESTARD · CPAM TEST 94 · MUTUELLE EXEMPLEDoctor and payers (invented). Already in Salesforce.

Screen words, Airpur words

The app is built on a retail package, so the labels on screen are not Airpur's words.

Before you start: three habits

Look first

Open the tab (Patients or Divers entités) and type the name in the box above the list. Creating a patient, doctor or payer twice breaks the reports, and V2 refuses a second patient with the same code and doctor.

Work from the patient page

Everything is created from the patient's own page, with the New button of each list (in V2 the lists are grids with a search box). The new record is then already linked to her.

On the phone too

Technicians use the Salesforce mobile app almost as often as the computer. It shows the same records, fields and buttons, one column at a time; buttons hide under ▾ or « Show more ».

Red * = required

A green message means saved. A red message means nothing was saved: read it, fix the named field, save again.

The links open PreProd, the test copy of Salesforce, and ask for your PreProd login. The data there is not the invented data drawn above, so compare the layout, fields and buttons, not the names. A form opened from a link is the standard form: buttons inside lists and menus follow the package's own routing, so use the instruction under the screen for those.

Orange rings mark what to fill or click; the arrow marks the button to press now. ← → keys move between screens.

What was created, and how it is linked
